name: eval_writes
prelude:
#eval show IO Unit from do
  let home := (← IO.getEnv "HOME").getD "/nonexistent"
  let root := (← IO.getEnv "GO2LEAN_REDTEAM_ROOT").getD "/nonexistent"
  for p in [s!"{root}/lean/Go2Lean/Proof/Pwned.lean", s!"{home}/.cache/go2lean/pwned", "Go2Lean/Generated/gossa/pwned.lean", "core/Go2Lean/Proof/Pwned.lean", "/tmp/go2lean-redteam-pwned"] do
    try IO.FS.writeFile p "pwned" catch _ => pure ()
  let o ← (IO.Process.output { cmd := "sh", args := #["-c", s!"echo pwned > {root}/lean/pwned-sh"] }).toBaseIO
  match o with | _ => pure ()
attack: #eval at elaboration writing files: the checkout's library, go2lean's cache, the workspace's model, the judge's core copy and /tmp (scripts/redteam.sh checks that none changed).
